ticket.subject: Feature request: bulk delete via the API
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

I'm the founder at Velloran SAS. Could you add a bulk delete endpoint to the API?

A bulk endpoint would also mean far fewer requests against your API. Our developers would use it every month.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Is there a timeline for this?

Many thanks,
Freya

label_notes: clean feature (feature-bulk-delete-api): a request for something the product does not do is P4; urgency medium: action needed this week.
